title: Impact
notes: Hits feel heavier: short hit-stop and a camera punch on crits and skill hits.
Multi-kills: DOUBLE KILL, TRIPLE KILL and MASSACRE when enemies fall close together.
Finisher moment: slow motion and a big K.O. when the last enemy drops.
Boss phases: below 50% HP gate bosses become ENRAGED (faster, stronger, red aura). Below 30% they call reinforcements.
